title: Travel: Paul McCartney – New York to Los Angeles | 1974
content:
Paul and Linda McCartney flew from New York to Los Angeles on 3 June 1974.

They checked in to the Beverly Hills Hotel, where they remained for three nights. While in Los Angeles, Paul recorded his song ‘Let’s Love’ with Peggy Lee at Record Plant West.
